chunks: What Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who begins the recitation in the salat (prayer): should he recite Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim? He said: Yes. When he begins the salat (prayer), then let him say it at the beginning of what he starts, then that suffices him for what comes after that.

key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ: the basmalah to be recited at the opening

ai.seo_question: Should Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim be recited when beginning recitation in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding recitation in salat (prayer), affirming that one should say Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim when beginning the prayer recitation. It indicates that saying it at the initial opening is sufficient for what follows thereafter.
